name: Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
equipment: A quiet space, seated or lying down
instructions: Sit or lie down comfortably with your spine tall and shoulders relaxed.
Exhale fully, then inhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold the breath gently for a count of 4 — no straining.
Exhale slowly through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold the breath out for a count of 4, then begin the next round.
Repeat for 4 rounds, keeping each side of the "box" the same length.
